title: Hidden Cost Of Car Loans

scenes.text: A $20,000 car loan at 5% adds $2,500 in interest
A five‑year loan of $20,000 at a 5% APR results in $2,618 total interest paid, according to standard amortization tables.
Paying an extra $100 each month cuts the loan term to 38 months and saves about $1,200 in interest.
